Final.dc.html.title: Chosen · desktop (B + story panel + zoom in the frame)

howto.text:
Try it: press Play on either artboard.

• Next / Previous, or the timeline dots, change chapter. A company enters the bubble when it is first mentioned (outlined in blue in that chapter); bubbles grow over time.
• The view is a camera inside the round frame: it flies to the players of the current chapter or news item and zooms to fit them. Story = loose framing; Explore = exactly the players of that news item, others faded. + / − nudge the zoom; the corners button fits the players again.
• Story / Explore switch at the top (phone: in the bottom sheet). Explore steps through sample news items.
• 'Read the story' opens every chapter, past and next; tap one to jump there.
• Money arrows: blue = investment, orange = cloud deal, teal = chip deal.
• Dashed square in a bubble = slot for the company's black-and-white logo.

Chapters are samples; the real ones come from your fact sheet.

theme.text:
Shared theme
Paper #F5EFE3 (warm cream) · ink #1B1A17 · secondary text #57534B · rules #CFC5B2 · accent deep blue #1E3A8A (Tweaks on each page to try other blues).

Free fonts, one pair per direction to compare:
A: Newsreader + Public Sans
B: Instrument Serif + Instrument Sans
C: Source Serif 4 + IBM Plex Sans

Placeholders: bubble sizes are a sample layout, not data. Values, amounts and most dates are [brackets]. Chapter text is yours to write. Money links show the kind of deals the site will track; amounts come from the checked data.
